The much-awaited sequel to BLAME! follows a man, called a Dismantler, who is in charge of sub-dividing the nexus towers that incur Safeguard interference upon its detection of humans without the net terminal genes. Although humans are once again able to reside in the Net Sphere, the Safeguard are still a threat. The Dismantler or NSE, or Net Sphere Engineer, goes on a journey to aid mankind in their survival.

7. Pump (ポンプ); unpublished, later collected in "Akai Kiba" doujinshi

8. BLAME!² - Dai 8-keishitai Pcell no Toshi Kouzoutai Dasshitsuki (BLAME!² 第八系子体プセルの都市構造体脱出記); Morning Zoukan Mandala 2008
The protagonist is a descendant of Pcell. This story happens a long time after the events of BLAME!. This young silicon creature knows well the havoc that Killy brought and decides to move towards the end of the megastructure, to look for him.

9. Numa no Kami (沼の神); Afternoon 2008-10

10. Senshi Kouchuu Suzumega (戦翅甲蟲・天蛾); Young Gangan 2007#3

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.native: ブラム学園! アンドソーオン 弐瓶勉作品集

47369.description:
Involves kidnapping and "training" of sorts.

1. Ansagerin (Announcer) (Ansagerin <アナウンサー>)
2. Frau (Onna) (Frau <女>)
3. Tier (Kemono) (Tier <獣>)
4. Hundin (Mesu Inu) (Hundin <牝犬>)
5. Ehefrau (Tsuma) (Ehefrau <妻>)
6. Braut (Hanayome) (Braut <花嫁>)
7. Ehepaar (Fuufu) (Ehepaar <夫婦>)
8. Affen liebe (Mouai) (Affen liebe <盲愛>)
9. Menschlichkeit (Ningensei) (Menschlichkeit <人間性>)
10. Sollen (Toui) (Sollen <当為>)

47370.description:
2000 years ago, Naotsu country. There are two families in power, the Takamahara house and the Yasuna house, who are always fighting. Yasuna house's son Izusami and Takamahara house's daughter Kayana fall in forbidden love. In the final battle of the war, the white-winged Kayana confronted the black-winged Izusami, and Izusami was killed. Thus the war ended, and Kayana took the throne. But, her pure white wings turned jet black...
2000 years later, in Takamahara country, where such a myth remains, an accident occurs involving a girl named Aki...

title.native: カヌチ 白き翼の章

47371.description: Takimura has a very unusual job: he's one of Hell's authorised personnel - and he's still alive! He's also attracted the attention of none other than the King of Hell himself, Enma, who greets Takimura every workday with the question, "Have you decided to become mine yet?"

47372.description: This manga is about the job of cleaning up scenes of death, and discusses the meaning of life and death. Through interactions between the deceased's family and friends with the death sweepers, we understand the meaning of death. No matter is it is a peaceful death at the ends of one's life, murder, suicide, death from illnesses, when death comes, who would be able to predict it, or prevent it? That is why we have to try our best to live on.

47373.description: Comic anthology featuring the characters from the otome game Starry★Sky ~in Spring~.

title.native: Starry☆Sky~in spring~コミックアンソロジー

47374.description:
The royal palace of the kingdom of Alba Forest received one letter of advance notice. That is, "We shall take the last treasure left behind by the late king to his beloved daughter, Violet." The sender of that letter was a group of robbers called the "Three Beasts." When Violet meets one of them by chance, the crow, her life changes greatly...!

Note: Includes three volume exclusive extras at the end of volumes 2, 3 and 4: chapters 5.5, 8.5 and 12.5.
synonyms: The Princess and the Three Beasts

47376.description: A humorous take on the author's sentiments for 'Oyaji' (Old men) in Yaoi.

title.native: オヤジ回廊へようこそ

47377.description:
Satoshi told his brother he has a cute girl friend, so when his bluff gets called he asks his best friend Yakumo to dress up as a girl and go on a date with him.

[Fr:Mangaupdates]

47379.description: Prepubescent girl and middle age man swap bodies in accident. The man in girl´s body run to a toilet; things get more bizarre when he/she opens the bag the girl was carrying.

47381.description: Two futanari twins rape another set of twins.

47382.description:
Young Akane-chan finds an egg, and decides to put it in an incubator, to see what would happen.
What comes forth? Well, let's just say "Something Nasty".

47383.description:
A series of Maria-sama ga Miteru comic anthologies published by Noir Shuppan featuring short stories from a number of different contributors. (Artist information for all four volumes can be found under "More Info")

The second volume has been translated by Lililicious and contains a number of short stories:

"Treasure" (Hirota Kaoru); a discussion between Youko and Yumi that offers a glimpse at the traditions between soeurs and their rosaries
"Canon" (Hane); when Yumi is feeling depressed, Sachiko takes some time out to comfort her.
"Finder" (Yuuki Kagura); emotions captured on camera give Tsutako an excuse to speak with Shouko
"Guidance Counselling" (Suzumiya Kiriha); after seeing Yumi talking with a friend, Sei starts to think about what she wants to do in the future.
"Border Line" (Kodama Naoko); Yoshino and Rei's are enjoying spending time togetherm but tender awkwardness turns into paranoid second guessing as each wishes the other would make the first move.
"Will" (Natsu-shi)
Natsushi's "Will"; a frank and emotional discussion between Rosa Canina and Shimako about the past, the future, faith, and finding the strength to stand on your own feet.
"The Hanging Garden" (Shirogane Hina) is about the flower garden Shimako tends, her relationship with Sei who visits it, and what happens when they find each other there.
"Their Soiree" (Nyoi); a short story where Shimako and Noriko get to know each other and go on a visit to an amusement park during summer vacation.
"Their Relationship" (Akimoto Nana); focuses on Shimako as she ponders the relationship she shares with Sei, how it differs from the relationships between the other Soeurs, and how she feels about it. "The Secret Garden 2" (also by Akimoto Nana) is a comedic 2 page short featuring Sei provoking Sachiko by pointing out how she acts around Yumi.
"Parachute Limit" (Murasakino Misato); after getting caught in a downpour Shimako and Noriko rush home to dry off. When Noriko becomes ill as a result, Shimako takes care of her and they share a tender moment.
Arai Miyako also has stories in the anthology; three comedic shorts about how some of the grande soeurs chose who would be their petite soeur.


Source: Ephidel/MAL.

title.native: 薔薇物語　プティ・スール マリみてコミックアンソロジー

47384.description:
Compilation edition of four Rokuda's One-shots published between 1992 and 1995 about the relationship between man and sky.

The stories are collected in the following order:
1. Return of the Heroes [ 勇者達の帰還 ]; Young Sunday Shinjinoo (02 October 1992)
2. The plaything of the orphans [ 孤児達の玩具 ]; Monthly Big Gold #1 (17 December 1992)
3. Seven Days [ セブンデイズ ]; Weekly Shounen Sunday #35-36 (August 1993)
4. Friend [ フレンド ]; BIG COMIC (25 January 1995)

Note:
Like many other Rokuda titles the stories featured here were later republished in a full color edition.

47385.description:
Itou Maasa is about as accurately named a girl as you can imagine. Unlike her mother (whom she lives with – she has no memory of her father) she’s a morning person, energetic and full of life. She’s just transferred to a new school, and is about to garner the attention of three different boys, brothers, all named Hiroshi…

Included one-shot:
Volume 1: Uchuusen Alfafa (宇宙船アルファルファ)
Volume 3: Shigotoba Houmon (仕事場訪問); Cinderella Boys (シンデレラ・ポイズ)
Volume 8: Hinagiku Kaidan (雛菊街道)
Volume 9: Time Table (タイム・テーブル)

47386.description: Tsumaki is a private investigator of the “Aaah Detective Agency” that is obviously listed on the first line of the phone book. He has a great love toward investigation, and aims to solve new cases with his keen and original insight, yet always tends to fail miserably. No wonder he’s pinched to pay his rent… With the support of his colleagues, powerful action, and elaborated costumes, he tries to solve crimes in his original ways!

47387.description:
1.Akai Megami (赤い女神)
Miya goes with her father (scientist) to an island, where he suppouse to find the last humans with red skin. On their journey, they have to face with racial discrimination in- and outside their journey group...

2. Napoleon to Watashi (ナポレオンと私)
3. Luna no Kyuujitsu (ルナの休日)
4. Yukidaruma no Miteitanashi (雪だるまの見ていたはなし)
synonyms: 雪だるまの見ていたはなし

47388.description:
1. Juusangatsu no Higeki (13月の悲劇)
After Marie loses her mother, her father sends her to a religious boarding school. First she just thinks this school is strict, but then she finds out, that there are happening weird things...
2. Susume! Badi (進め！バディ)
3. Lotte no Koibito (ロッテの恋人)
4. Yama no Tsuki to Kodanuki to (山の月と子だぬきと)
synonyms: Yama no Tsuki to Kodanuki to

47389.description:
1. Pandora no Himitsu (パンドラの秘密)
Aime is a girl, who has a sixth sense. she always wears a scarf, because she has a mark on her throat. First she doesn't know why she has them, but then she finds out what this mark and her supernatural power really means...
2. Hibari Naku Asa (ひばり鳴く朝)
3. Tanabata (たなばた)

47390.description:
In the southwest area of the Zemulia Continent, one will find the tiny Liberl Kingdom. A small monarchy that has managed to defy all odds against attempts to overcome them during war. Liberl is split into five regions: Rolent, Bose, Ruan, Zeiss, and Grancel. In the city of Rolent, Cassius Bright has raised two children by himself, Estelle and Joshua.

He taught them everything they know himself, and encourages them to sign up to become apprentices in the Bracers Guild. Soon after, however, he receives a letter and has to leave on business, leaving Estelle and Joshua to fend for themselves. While working, they receive notice one day that their father's airship has gone missing. With this in mind, the two gear themselves up, and set off to find the ship and save their father.

(Source: Sora no Kiseki Translation Project)
synonyms: The Legend of Heroes VI: Sora no Kiseki

title.native: 英雄伝説 空の軌跡

47391.description: Arika is afraid of boys, because she was mobbed by them in grade school. Because of this experience, she went to a girl's school, but then the girl's school decides to merged with a boy's school...

47392.description: Kirei Suzuki is a editor of an entertainment magazine. This manga tells her and others everday life in form of oneshots.

47393.description: Baku is an illustrator. One day he buys a little rabbit, while he is drunken. First he couldn't handle with it (he named it Sentaro), but after a tragedy story he notices, that he grows fond of it. This manga tells the story of Baku and Sentaro's everyday life.

47394.description:
Hiyori is an extremely shy high school freshman. For some reason, she started high school later than everyone else. She falls in love with Hirose-kun, who is in the same class and sits next to her. He's always surrounded by people, cheerful and fun, and the complete opposite of her...!?

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

47395.description: Kouma is virtually predisposed to falling in love wherever he goes, but he’s constantly grating on people’s nerves and he’s the king of getting his heart broken. But what happens when a strange yet handsome fortune-teller makes a bold prediction—that Kouma will soon meet the man of his destiny!? And later, what is Kouma to make of it when he reunites with the fortune-teller and begins to fall in love with him…?! Set in a magic shop and dealing with the sweetest of living arrangements, Rico Fukiyama depicts a sweet love story of magical happiness. (source = dokidokibooks)

47396.description:
Toba Yousuke sensei went to Town Alp to start afresh. He got lost and met a strange guy, Suga Kazuhiro, who went to pick him up. The folks in the town were extremely friendly, except for Kazuhiro. Because his room in the clinic collasped, Toba had to stay in Kazuhiro's huge house for a while. What were the reasons behind Kazuhiro's personality? What happened to Toba that made him to come to this town? With hidden pasts, both of them slowly found their ways into each other’s heart.

Note: Includes one extra
synonyms: きら星ダイヤル－その後－

47397.description:
1-2) Yamada runs away from home and goes to hang out at the school until things cool down. Unfortunately he runs into his homeroom teacher who takes him home.

3-5) Ikeda moves into his dormitory to find out his room mate Kazuma has a terrible personality.

47401.description:
Single ladies sure have it tough! Eligible bachelorettes Aeri Goo and Nagyung couldn't agree more. Both are established career women, and though they approach dating from the opposite ends of the spectrum, their goal is the same: Find that special connection. The flighty but sweet-hearted Aeri is focused on finding a hot piece to give her some much-needed TLC, but she can't seem to attract an acceptable potential partner without resorting to...dare we say it? A blind date! Her sexy roommate Nagyung, on the other hand, can't seem to fend off a constant stream of playboy pursuers. Too bad they all seem more interested in her good looks than who she is as a person—so not what she is looking for!
Watch and laugh with the single ladies of Please, Please Me as they commiserate over botched blind-dates, wannabe-pimp playas, and even a wardrobe malfunction or two! For these gals, life is one big party and it's all in the name of love!

(Source: Netcomics)

47402.description: Roa Coatl is on a mission. He must find the descendant of Quetzalcoatl to make her his wife and continue his great race of dragons. However, with no knowledge about love and having no interest in women, will he be able to accomplish his task in human world?

47405.description:
When Ageha was little she watched a tennis game and was affected by a passionate young tennis player. Years later she was determined to become a number one tennis player and to join the tennis club in her new high school.

Unexpectedly, on her first day of school she finds out that her new seat mate is none other than Takeru, the tennis player she was inspired from. But her excitement lasts shortly since Takeru turns out to be a jerk and he even gave up on tennis. When things couldn't turn worser, Ageha realises that there isn’t any tennis club in her school! Despite the unlucky start, she is still determined to create the Tennis Club and she works overnight for days to clean the tennis court all on her own. She also keeps practicing alone even though her rackets had been broken days before by Takeru. But her perseverance is slowly touching the boy. Surprisingly, he shows up during her training dressed in a tennis gear. And he even gives Ageha a new tennis racket and starts coaching her. Is this the start of a new love on the tennis field?

47411.description:
After his mother deserted them, senior high school student, Reo was living together with his mother's stern ex-lover, the very imposing uncle Shuuji. But 2 months ago, as he dropped by his home on his way with a friend one evening, an event occurred that changed their relationship forever.
His senses were suddenly muddled and when he came to, he was being held by his uncle. Since that day, his uncle demands his body for pleasure and Reo who has been suffering ever since seeks his close friend Kenta’s advice but…

Also included in this volume is a cute story of mutual love between a kouhai and senpai!

47412.description: Doujinshi for one-shot Honeycomb Child from Rakuen no Pet.
synonyms: HONEYCOMB CHILD dj - HONEYCOMB CHILD S

47413.description: Story about Keisuke and Aki 3 years later.

47414.description:
Yuuna is the proud owner of Yuuri an android who was designed to look like Yuuna's twin. However, now that Yuuri is back from a tune up at his creators he's acting a bit different. Seems he wants to tie up Yuuna... how will this seme react to the tables being turned?!

Note: Originally self-published, was then licensed by Frontier Works for digital release.

synonyms: I Know Who That Man Is

title.native: 나는 그 남자가 누구인지 알고 있다

47416.description: Kaibara Yousuke is a third-year college student looking for employment. During his second year, he'd immediately rebuffed his classmate Nakayamada Kazuki's offer: “Won't you have sex with me?” But that time, Kazuki's declaration of, “I could make you feel so good, you wouldn't be able to think of anything else,” was the beginning of their relationship. At first, Yousuke would shy away from sex, but he was healed by the unexpectedly tolerant Kazuki, and was gradually captivated.

47417.description:
Hino Akiharu lost his parents when he was an elementary student and was taken in by his uncle's family. One day, he sees on the news about the newly-established Hakureiryou Gakuin, a school which was re-built from an elite girls' school. He decides to take the exam for that school and succeeds in entering the House Management Department (the place to train maids & butlers). He wants to become a butler, although his appearance scares the ladies. Akiharu has a sinister look in his eyes, a scar on his right eyebrow, and bristled up hair. Add 3 piercings on his ears and he indeed has a typical bad boy look on him.

He meets his "nemesis" at that school, Saikyou Tomomi, a girl with a two faced character who traumatized him many times since they were kids. Another girl named Cernia Iori FlameHeart chases after him because of his looks and calls him suspicious. Still, Akiharu starts finding his feet at the school and his relationships with the girls also get better...

47418.description: Jio is a young magic user whose goal is to one day become the greatest magic user in the world! He lives a sheltered life with his master Iregaura, until the events of one day leave him to journey out into the world alone. Jio, whose magical specialty is making flowers bloom, has a lot to learn about the world outside his home, but he is still determined to achieve his goal!
synonyms: Jio to Ogon to Kinjirareta Mahou
Jio to Oogon to Kinjirareta Mahou
Jio and Ougon and the Forbidden Magic

title.native: ジオと黄金と禁じられた魔法
title.romaji: Jio to Ougon to Kinjirareta Mahou

47420.description: High school student Suzuko Yotsuya runs the Yotuya Cafe with her older brother Takuki. However, due to a real estate agent's deception, Yotuya Cafe is located on a cliffside famous for being a suicide spot, and furthermore, due to her brother's perverted behavior, not many customers come to the café.

47421.description: For salary man Kotaro Takami, heaven is a gravure model named Misaki Hoshino. Now his dream may be coming true; the TV station he works for wants to use Hoshino for their new promotion--and Takami is in charge of PR for the station! But the perfect day seems to go very wrong when he accidentally walks in a girl changing her costume. With her glasses, braided pony-tails (and hot bod) Takami finds himself falling in love. But just who is she...?

47428.description:
Breakout actor, Izumi Hayato, is charismatic and energetic in front of the camera but once the cameras are off Izumi becomes an expressionless antisocial person. Because of his introverted personality, Izumi's manager, Miyano Souta always has a hard time dealing with him.

Unbeknownst to others, Izumi's icy personality isn't intentional. And despite his cold personality, costar Saotome Hijiri still attempts to get close to Izumi. Soon, the cheerful Saotome's personality starts to have an effect on Izumi, but not one that he expects or one Saotome's manager wants. Can Izumi overcome his ineptness in communicating long enough to express his love to Saotome and win Saotome's heart? (manga-updates)

47432.description: Manhwa by Chul-Ho Park (story) & Sung-Jae Kim (art).

47433.description:
1. Usubeni no Arashi
The title story is a slice-of-life school sports manga about a pair of brothers who both play baseball. While the eldest is a pitcher for a top-tier team with chances at winning the prestigious Koshien tournament, the youngest is a mediocre player with an attitude who has never gotten over the death of their father several years prior.

2. Sora o Aogu Hana

3. Saigo no Kataomoi

47435.description: Momoko is a fan of Hero shows, like the Power Rangers. The boy she liked in Junior High says mean things about her obsession and breaks her heart. In High School, Momoko tries to reinvent herself, and throws away all her Hero souvenirs. But at school, she is asked to join a Hero Club with 3 tall, handsome members who dress up as Hero characters and patrol the school. They want her to be their Pink Ranger. Even though the other girls are jealous, Momoko is too scarred by her past to embrace her love of Hero stories, and she doesn't get along at all with the Red Ranger.

47436.description:
Just when Yamamura Fuuta is looking forward to his last summer vacation as a grade-schooler, the self-proclaimed miraiya barges into his life and turns what should have been an idyllic vacation into a series of events shrouded in mystery and filled with spine-tingling encounters. Strange things begin to surface all around the skeptical and unwilling Fuuta.

This is a manga adaptation of Hayamine Kaoru’s novel of the same name. Squeal, gasp, cringe, tremble, but don’t forget to peek between your fingers from time to time as mangaka Takemoto Itoe adroitly transports you to the quiet, fictitious, rural town of Kamikushichou, where the woods are brimming with life in the vibrant Japanese summer.

(Source: etc)

47437.description: Mahiru goes in search of her sister who has been missing for 2 years now and meets Yukito claiming to be a bodyguard and her proxy. He warns her that her sister is probably involved in something dangerous, but she can't give up. This choice forever changes her.

47441.description:
History's worst wanted man, Grizzly. Bounty hunters began to gather in the land where he had boldly made his home. A new bounty hunter will appear again today too...
(Source: Hyper Parfait)

title.native: テリヤキウエスタン－史上最凶の無法都市－
title.romaji: Teriyaki Western: Shijou-sai Kyou no Muhou Toshi

47442.description: The predecessor of Dragon Tiger Gate was originally called Little Rascals, created by Hong Kong comics master Wong Yuk-long. Founded in 1970, he created the brothers Wang Xiaohu and Wang Xiaolong, while Shi Heilong was the protagonist of his other famous comic, Judo Devil Boy. The story begins with Wang Xiaohu, who arrives in Hong Kong from mainland China to search for his family. He befriends four young warriors, then battles a villain, ultimately defeating good, and this cycle continues. This cycle continues until the "Tsuen Wan Fifteen Wolves," where the story begins its long-running arc. The leader of the Tsuen Wan Fifteen, the Great Wolf King, is revealed to be a deadly demon who was a disciple of the Rakshasa Cult, Japan's leading yakuza. This leads to the Rakshasa Cult campaign, with the protagonists breaking out of Hong Kong and embarking on an expedition to Japan. This was a significant breakthrough at the time, and with the 99th issue, Little Rascals officially changed its name to Dragon Tiger Gate. The three emperors, Dragon and Tiger, are each handsome and imposing, captivating countless young women. But most of the beautiful women who admired them met tragic end. True to their beauty, beauty often leads to tragic fates. Today, let's discuss Wang Xiaolong's ill-fated love. Wang Xiaolong was a solitary and impulsive person, and his only true love in life was Yu'er. Yu'er, the daughter of a sword demon, cultivated the Jade Maiden Heart Sutra and Jade Maiden Finger. She fell in love with Wang Xiaolong at first sight and remained devoted to him until her death. Unfortunately, her beauty attracted the coveted Fire Cloud Evil God, who ultimately raped her and committed suicide. Her devotion to Wang Xiaolong is truly admirable! After Yu'er's death, Wang Xiaolong felt almost heartbroken. Coupled with his disfigurement, he suffered from extreme self-esteem and abandoned any desire for romance. Later, in Japan, he met Lingzhi, the daughter of Nangong Yizhi, one of the five great families of the alliance. The two fell in love, but due to complex circumstances, their feelings remained vague and elusive. Later, in an attempt to help Xiaohu regain his power, Lingzhi was forced into marriage by the evil monk Jinzhong, and was subsequently abducted and raped... Wang Xiaolong was very anxious when he learned that Lingzhi had been abducted. It was then that he realized that Lingzhi's position in his heart was no less than Yu'er's. Unfortunately, Lingzhi also followed Yu'er's footsteps...

47443.description:
Scarred by domestic violence and the sudden departure of her mother and her younger brother, Satsuki doesn't know how to trust people. Renai Anagram is the story of a young woman's struggles to overcome her past and learn how to accept and value herself.

(Source: One Snowshoe)

47445.description:
A young knight from a destitute noble family trying to live up to the ideals of a true knight, and leaves to learn form a much older knight.

7 Years go by and........

title.native: 紅の騎士ロックウェル

47446.description: Noumo Kanaiita Kitte Yarakaashi Hoi Outoigonsu, called Watanabe for short, is an alien from a planet 20000 light years away. He is at homestay in Japan to do research for his thesis on earthling culture.

47449.description: Fictional Space War loosely based on WWII. Story centers on the lives of a 4-men squadron.

47450.description:
School janitor Suguri has a second job…as a call-boy! When his work suddenly brings him to the door of a teacher from his school, he’s convinced the whole affair will be unbearably awkward. But Suguri soon discovers that this is one client who loves to indulge his sweet tooth!

Priceless Honey succumbs to sticky-sweet surrender in stories of naive love and indecent lust! Will faces from the past deliver peerless pleasure…or bitter disappointment? Which men will find the courage to take a bite out of the forbidden fruit of love?

(Source: Juné)

title.native: プライスレス・ハニー

47451.description:
Eita refuses to admit his bad mood is due to being lonely, but when his "friend" for the past year, Kamiyama-senpai, heads off to college, he has to face the truth of their relationship.
(from Yes_Rhade)

47452.description: Colonel Rosenberg conducting a home visit to his subordinates' homes.
synonyms: Datenshi ni Sasageru Uta dj - Family Visit

title.romaji: Datenshi ni Sasageru Uta dj - Kateihoumon

47453.description: The Army is gearing up for their leave now that they have their bonus in hand. Red Light District, here they come...?

title.romaji: Datenshi ni Sasageru Uta dj - Harem Nights

47456.description: Sunao Konoe starts her first day at a new school and is surprised to find that there is no drama club. So, she decides to make one of her own. But between a childhood friend showing up, the crazy student body, and the arrogant student council president blocking her at every turn, it seems that actually creating the club is going to be more difficult than she thought.

47457.description: "After School" deals mainly with the psychological tension between a warden and his inmate, a prodigy of such profound genius that she fears she could design a weapon that would destroy the entire world.

47461.description: Namu goes to a school where all the elites get idolized by the 'non-elites'. From models to computer geniuses, these students make tons of money on their own! Because the school gates are always crowded by screaming fans of these elites, it is difficult for Namu to get to class on time. One day, however, a new transfer student helps Namu out in her morning predicament. Guess who gets categorized as an elite almost immediately?

47462.description: Kyouko (21) and Jiro (23) live together in Tokyo as an unmarried couple. She was a graphic artist in an advertisement agency, and he was just starting out as an illustrator. In a world on the verge of a sexual revolution, this is the story of their daily life with friends and family, and the struggles of their relationship.

47463.description:
Futatsu Makura takes us into the pleasure district of Yoshiwara, where courtesans and their clients meet in the ancient city of Edo. From the most famous teahouses to the most disreputable, in each room, a woman and a man talk to each other, before moving on to serious matters that no longer need words.
The drawings are directly inspired by famous prints of Hokusai or Utamaro. The dialogues are of extreme sophistication while touching the essence of intimacy, making us feel all the nuances of relationships and expectations, hopes and fears, rivalries and pride.
This works makes live the intimacy of hearts and minds, in this world of pleasures which is only the exacerbated reflection of a whole society.

(Source: Editions Picquier, translated & adapted)

47465.description:
The year is 1967, and a young Japanese man is thinking about the future. On one side of the water, the war is raging in Vietnam; far away on the other side, the Apollo Project has just met with disaster as three astronauts die in a capsule fire. And here and now, on a long nighttime ferry ride back home, he will meet and fall in love with a mysterious young woman who carries a past deeper and more profound than his dreams and fears of tomorrow. Her name, she jokes, is no name—Emanon, and she can never be forgotten, any more than she can forget.

(Source: Dark Horse)

47468.description:
A loose adaptation of the Kamen Rider BLACK TV series featuring more carnal and insect-like designs and a darker plot.

Note: Chapter count reflects the original serialization in Weekly Shounen Sunday. The chapters were later combined into 23 chapters for the tankōbon release.

47471.description: Mari Amachi is a very devout Christen who transfers to Perfect Religion Academy.  A school devoted to all religions of the world in effort to make it's students the next world leaders in religion.  Her friend Saori is kidnapped by the Black Budda cult which is a group who wishes to take away religious freedom though force and brainwashing.  Mari prays to God for help but Buddha answers the call!  Mari accepts only to help her friend and she is transformed into Butt Attack Punisher Girl Gotaman.  Between fighting bad guys, making a deal with Buddha, and wearing  scandalous costume is it more then Mari can take?

title.native: 臀撃おしおき娘ゴータマン

47473.description: Jin (female) and Konoe (male) are twins and are just starting their high school career. Jin has always been a trouble to her brother, since she's very tough and violent, and generally doesn't behave like a girl at all. Konoe is determined that their high school life is going to be different, and he's going to make sure she keeps acting cute and feminine. But it isn't easy for Jin to pretend to be something she's not…

47475.description: The heart of Shao-Mi's dead boyfriend was transplant to another boy, that goes to another school -- Yi Tang-Yao. Like many other guys Ming Xiao Xi wrote about, he is tall, handsome, rich and cool... Shao-Mi did everthing to get close to Tan-Yao like doing his homework, run 1500 meters... Finally, Yi Tang-Yao accepted Shao-Mi and began to go out with her. But one day, Shao-Mi suddenly found out that her dead boyfriend's heart did not actually get transplanted onto Tan-Yao's body... and Yi Tang-Yao found out about the real reason that Shao-Mi wanted to get close to him...(source: Sherbet Lemon)
synonyms: There Will Be An Angel To Love You Instead of Me

title.romaji: Angel Will Love You Instead of Me

47476.description:
"Be my woman and I'll let you become a top singer!"

This is the statement made by Yukihito Yoshizawa, a famous and rich music producer. A female high school girl who wants to save her weak and sickly brother accept his terms by offering her voice and body. A passionate yet twisted entertainment love story thus begins!

1. Eniro*Cinderella
2. Eniro*Venus
3. Eniro*Juliet
4. Eniro*Muse
5. Eniro*Mermaid
6. Eniro*Diva

(Source: Transient Mirage)

47477.description: As a result of her "vigorous attitude", Ritsuka is known as the tomboy of Sakuraya police station. While on duty, she was accused of a cosplay scandal. Later on that day, she discovers a girl who was raped by an unknown man in the men's bathroom. With her fellow cops, she and two other policemen from the Criminal Investigation branch - Daisuke Takaya and Eiji Itsuki - attempt to find the suspect.

47478.description: The time is probably the 21st Century. In the Hinomoto Kingdom where the king has the kingdom under control with somewhat of peace, 3 rookie military officers, Haru, Natsuki, and Touma, are assigned with a very special mission: To protect the King's daughter! The three rejoice at this unexpected mission that their lieutenant provided them with, and they quickly arrive at the princess' room but find out that the princess is different than what they had expected..... A princess guardian comedy now begins!

47482.description: It's the 18th century in Naples, Italy. There is a girl named Maria living peacefully in the city, but she is more than she appears. She is like a goddess of death, with a sword that cuts through everything. But what exactly is she? Where has she come from and what cruel destiny awaits her?

47484.description: In this special edition of the teenage basketball manga classic, "DEAR BOYS," Takumi Fujiwara and Ranmaru Miura of Mizuho Junior High meet Tsutomu Ishii and Kenji Dobashi from Takakura Junior High at a Mizuho High basketball game. The four boys aim to be the number one basketball player. Fans of "Dear Boys" will want to read about how the four first met, three years before the "DEAR BOYS" saga begins.

47486.description:
By all accounts, middle schooler Seigi is pretty unremarkable except for his martial arts prowess and a desire to protect the weak. But when his good intentions are put to the test by saving an old homeless man from some street thugs, the mysterious man shows his gratitude by...burning a tattoo onto Seigi's palm?! It turns out, the tattoo is a powerful secret weapon that everyone--including a formidable girl with a tattoo of her own--is after. With his life on the line and his martial arts skills alone no match against super-powered foes, will Seigi be able to unlock the latent potential of his tattoo and live to fight another day?!

(Source: Yen Press)

47488.description:
The main girl's older twin brother is an enhanced human. People like him are genetically engineered as a human survival project. She is constantly being compared to him and is always trying her best to catch up to her twin.
She meets another enhanced human, Iron. They fell in love with each other.
But there are many obstacles: an accident making her to live her brother twin's life. Such as the conspiracy to create a super human commanding all enhanced humans. And the candidate is Iron. Such as Iron is unconsciously turning into a beasty killing machine.

47489.description: Heidi just wanted a job. Philip just wanted to get over the death of his fiance by drowning himself with his work. A chance encounter in the elevator leads the two down the path of a sexy spy romance!

47490.description: He, who is praised "the hands of Midas" by the artist world, can turn an unknown to the world superstar. But when it's with Demi Caughes, can his hands be use into effect or is it he who will be affected?

47491.description: About a husband and wife who are spouses on paper only (live in the same house, but separate rooms; same company [he is the president, she is a worker], but act as strangers) falling in love with each other.

47493.description:
Two fantasy stories with a rich sense of celtic folklore. The first story, "On the Riverbank of Lethe", tells a strange encounter of a memory-lost amazon warrior and a mysterious bard with a broken-string unicorn-shaped harp. The second, title story, is about the bard’s past when he first met his red-headed amazon princess.

(Source: Wingtip Cafe)
synonyms: 風の呪歌 射千玉の髪の姫君

47495.description: Touko Momozono is a bright and eager shitamachi girl. She lives with an unwed mother and grandmother, all-female household. Her father had already gone when she was born, but she lived in comfort. Only there was a gaping hole opened in her heart. Recently she has often been an easy target for molsters and thugs, and Kazunari, who is usually boring and one of her colleagues, helps her ride out such a crisis. What is hidden behind his face? Why is she a target for a suspicious-looking man?

title.native: う・そ・つ・き★ナイト

47500.description:
Love? Family? Belonging? Takata tells himself he doesn't need them; a gay man like him can't have them.

Seno despises shameless Takata. Whenever Takata enters the coffee shop, Seno grits his teeth, barely manages to greet him, and tries not to think about how Takata destroyed his boss's marriage. But Seno makes a horrible assumption: he pins the cruel heart on the wrong man. His strong feelings morph into something more complicated than disgust. Can Seno convince Takata that creating a family doesn't rely on being "gay" or "straight"?

(Source: DMP)

47501.description:
Welcome to the future. In tried-and-true sci-fi fashion, the date is given in a time system that we have no reference for, so I can't tell you how far into the future we are beyond saying that it is S.E. 156. Thirty years before our story begins, an ace space pilot by the name of M2 Rimstein was put into an experimental cold sleep until such time as he would be needed.

That time is now. He is unfrozen and put in command of the Dance Mania unit of three superb pilots, though two are rookies: Stellasta von Argyll, Malloy Chihaya, and Cloud Neelsen. Accelerated training commences, and new ships and gadgets are brought out so that they will have victory over their enemy.

Unfortunately, things go awry fairly soon when M2 is captured and brain-washed by a planet which sends him out to fight for the enemy. Malloy at first refuses to fight his commander, and then does so with the conviction that he can bring him home to the Great Carrier.

Bringing him home may be easy, but regaining his mind?

47505.description:
A collection of three stories:

1) Come On! Clash Baby

2) Netsu no Hana
A mature man trapped in a loveless marriage encounters his unfaithful wife's latest lover: an impassive young man who has lost his sense of taste.

3) Lindaman

47507.description:
Collection of one-shots:

1. Hatsujou = Junjou☆Fantasy
2. Otouto☆Mania
3. Akuma na Cupid
4. Revenge wa Koi no Hajimari
5. Hore! Hore! Love Me
6. Mousou = Hakkin☆Fantasy

47508.description: A life in a Tokyo high school has only been my dream until now. On my first day in Tokyo, I came to the Blue Rose Dormitory. But why is the girls dormitory the home of all the hot guys!? What the hell is going on??
synonyms: You and the Blue Rose Dorm

title.romaji: Kimi to Ao Bara Ryou de

47509.description:
Compilation of short stories:
• Otome no Omocha
• Atashi no Omocha
• Koakuma Guardian
Natsume Mikana is a popular idol who was always being chased by many fans because of her looks. one day, while being chased by her fans, a boy riding a motorcycle suddenly grabbed her and brought her to the studio and was told that he is her bodyguard, but what will happen if the guy is her type but they are not able to fall in love with each other? will she give up to her feelings and confess, or will she pretend not love him and find someone else?

47510.description:
Renjouji Kiriya holds the coveted position of the number one ranked host at a high-class host club "Chateau du Amour" in Tokyo. The Chateau du Amour specializes in providing the company of beautiful, cultured men to female customers. Few people know that the popular Kiriya is actually Yamada Kotarou, a boy from Nagasaki who came to Tokyo to find a way to repay his parent's debt.

Some of the other hosts, jealous of his position, are determined to get past his perfect facade to discredit him. Kiriya will have a hard time stopping them, especially after a former customer dumps an adorable 5-year-old girl on him, claiming he is the father. The only thing that could make this situation more difficult would be the arrival of his Nagasaki girlfriend Miharu, who knows nothing of his career as a host...

(Source: Taciturnity Scans)

Included one-shot:
Apple!

47511.description:
Rihito promised himself that he’d never fall in love with a hetero or bisexual. However when Rihito’s shop manager, Kanda Kouji, confessed to him, he allowed Kanda to hold him. Ri-chan made it clear to Kanda that it’s impossible between them. But with Kanda’s continuous advances, will Ri-chan give in?

(Source: Attractive Fascinante)

47512.description:
Collection of one shots.

Shoujo Guard
Unlike other 16 years old, Miyako only knows how to be a bodyguard. Taken in by Haruka-sama after her father passed away, Miyako is determined to give her life to protecting Haruka-sama.

47513.description: Based off of the anime, the story is set in the future on a land that, after being scarred by long-lasting wars, has settled into quiet decline. Kanata Sorami is a 15-year-old girl who fulfills her dream of enlisting in the army and joins a unit of five girls who protect a fortress. The girls also play music that reverberate across the skies over towns without people and seas without fish.

47514.description: Keiichi is a pure-hearted boy having lot of sexual fantasies. Chihoru is a rude but feminine girl. This book describes sexual fantasies between Keiichi and Chihoru. They are always thinking of making love.

title.native: もっといちゃつきたいの

47517.description:
What do you get when you cross a microwave with a cell phone? Apparently, a time machine! Self-proclaimed mad scientist Okarin and the Future Gadgets team now have the ability to send text messages into the past. Will this newfound power be used for personal gain? To change the world? Or for something much more sinister... ?

(Source: Udon Entertainment)

title.native: シュタインズ・ゲート

47518.description:
The story centers around two twins, Arago and Yuan, whose parents were slaughtered by monsters. Years later, the vengeful Arago crosses paths with Yuan, who has since become a police officer, just as blood begins to flow again in the streets of London.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: AR∀GO -ロンドン市警特殊犯罪捜査官-

47519.description: Secretary Saito Yo was transferred to a new director named Nabeshima Hisatsugu after a recent reorganization. However, the supposedly “never worked a day in a company” Nabeshima had his new secretary totally wrapped around his finger! Not only that, Yo was further devastated when Nabeshima commented that Yo wasn’t what he thought a secretary should be. Shocked and frustrated, Yo carelessly blurted out while he was drunk one night that Nabeshima should “take advantage” of his services. Then the next day, Nabeshima totally changed his attitude—!?

47523.description:
What happens when Nagasaku, the president of the most popular cafe "Lotus" and Kouzuki, the number #1 host of the most popular club "Adonis" wanted to rent the same 2 million yen lavish apartment in the exclusive King's Hill? Room share, of course! Two unlikely roommates agreed to co-habitate the same apartment with very strict conditions. Will this arrangement really work out between these two semes...?

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

47525.description: Wakaba Chiharu is a fujoshi, but hides it from her friends. She fantasizes about male classmates being intimate and uses them for her manuscripts. But somebody is interfering with her daydreams...

47529.description: Aida Shizuka is three days from being executed for cruelly murdering his family when a shinigami comes to visit him. It's his little sister Hibiki, who has come to make sure his soul goes to hell! Hibiki has another job on this trip as well, granting the final wish of a girl with heart disease, and she drags her condemned brother along with her. Soon, it becomes apparent that people are not as simple as they may seem, and even Shizuka's guilt is uncertain. Hibiki and Shizuka promise to search together for the truth about their family's death, and they won't let life, death, or trouble in the afterlife get in their way!
synonyms: Shinigamisama ni Saigo no Onegai wo
The Final Wishes Granted by a Grim Reaper

title.native: 死神様に最期のお願いを
title.romaji: Shinigami-sama ni Saigo no Onegai wo

47532.description: Comic anthology featuring the characters from the otome game Starry☆Sky ~in Summer~.

title.native: Starry☆Sky ～in Summer～ コミックアンソロジー

synonyms: Otona Keikenchi dj - Boku wa Sunao ja Nai

47536.description: Tokyo Butei High School is a place where teenagers are trained to be "Butei", combat detectives. Tokyou Butei student Touyama Kinji, who is otherwise ordinary, has a special ability to go into "Hysteria Mode" that can trigger without his control when he is in close proximity to girls. In his Hysteria Mode, which he is trying to keep something of a secret, he becomes super powerful and very concerned with protecting women. One day Kinji is targeted by a Butei killer, who rigs his bicycle to explode, and is rescued by assault expert transfer student Aria H. Kanzaki. But after witnessing his Hysteria Mode, Aria will not leave him alone...

47537.description: After losing their parents at an early age, Natsuhiko and Haru had to be separated​. Years later, Natsuhiko opened a cafe hoping to fulfill his and his parents' dreams. After an incident with a customer, Natsuhiko finds out that he is his younger brother. Unfortunately, he now works as a host. Not only that, Natsuhiko had racked up plenty of debt to finance his cafe. Can Natsuhiko overcome these obstacles and convince his younger brother to come back and keep his cafe, and their dreams, alive?

title.native: キューカンバー×サンドイッチ

47540.description:
Tsubaki, a high-school student, lives together with his two older half-brothers. Their relationship is a bit unusual.

Note: Originally self-published, was then compiled and commercially released by Magazine Magazine on July 30, 2011.

47541.description: Based on the novel by Kaminaga Manabu. Shinrei Tantei Yakumo (Psychic Detective Yakumo) tells a story about a college student, Saitou Yakumo, who was born with different eye colors. His red left eye gives him the special ability to see ghosts and spirits. He believes ghosts and spirits are bound to earth because of a certain 'cause' and simply eliminating that 'cause' will let those spirits will rest in peace. Being asked for help by Ozawa Haruka, they begin the investigation together.

47543.description:
Eighteen year old Mitsuru Yaegashi has come to Tokyo to be an illustrator. But the place he planned to live, Tsumanuda, has legalized and organized street fighting! He meets the mysterious maid Dorae, and with her help steps into the world of martial arts. What awaits him there?

(Source: JManga)

47544.description:
The Demon King rules over all demons, and using his immense power, put the human race through 1,000 years of oppression. Thus, the human's era has ended and the demon's era has begun.

Lucifer has inherited the title of Demon King passed down from his father. However, rather than fight the humans, he much rather just get along with them. Not only that, he becomes sick at the sight of blood. Since all the humans knew where the Demon King's castle was, he was constantly trying to be killed by assassins. So he decided to leave the caste and live out in the wilderness where humans couldn't find him... or so he thought. Since every man with power has been defeated by him, the humans sent a girl to defeat him. How will Lucifer deal with this beauty sent to destroy him?

47545.description:
What is being sought after cannot be felt even on the fingertips. This is a series about the extravagant lifestyle of a tattoo artist named Gad, and the circle of people who revolve in it.

(Source: Stiletto Heels)

47546.description:
1-3) Ultras
A victory for the national team was decided in the European Football Championship that night. The whole country overflowed with joy, including Leon who drank, raised hell, and ended up spending a night together with "someone he should never have gotten involved with." That man's name was Al, from the rival team Liberta's ULTRAS supporters club! He understands that it will never work, but from their first meeting, Al is lodged firmly in his heart.

4) Say Hello to Mr. Smith
A suave conman, John Smith, bumps into a french man on the streets who tries to pick his pocket. The pickpocket, Jean, convinces the swindler to bring him home, but where will things go from here? John will soon learn that Jean is not just a pickpocket....

5) The Onlooker
A man with binoculars watches a single window, watching an tenant's every move. The apartment is filthy... and it excites the man who was raised to always "maintain a clean environment". His target, an author, releases a new book --- and the title is "The Onlooker" about a man who watches a single window...

6) Who Killed Oscar?
A complicated love story between a director and an actor. Tom shows up on Jim's door one day, years after they broke up, looking for inspiration for his scripts. Both men have fallen to very low points after having won an Oscar together 10 years before. Jim is acting in stage plays to pay his rent, while Tom's movies are all busts. Can the two men somehow create something beautiful once more?

7) Local y Visitante
Since he realized he liked guys, living in Spain was torment for Angel. After he migrated east (to Japan) he suddenly found himself popular with both men and women... even being nicknamed "Invincible Armada". All is useless however, since he can't get his target - Taka, his coworker. One day, one thing leads to another and Taka tells Angel he is gay too... but Taka's not his type!?

8) Tiempo Extras I+II (Ultras Extra)
Leon's grandpa finds out about him and Al.

47548.description:
Twins Ken and Mari and their friend Joe have been constant companions since childhood. Now in their final year of high school, they've grown into young adults with their own hobbies, loves, and even secrets. No matter their differences, though, they share a common bond in their love for movies. But will this bond prove to be strong enough when unresolved feelings and distance threaten to pull this threesome apart? KINE IN! collects the existing chapters of this bittersweet story, plus a newly written chapter! Also included are three one-shots where Est Em further explores the bonds of affection that draw friends and lovers of all kinds together.

(Source: DMG)

47551.description:
On her way home from the grocery store, Norie notices a cat girl huddled on the ground. It turns out she's a Nekomata called Tama (a nekomata is a "ghost cat" with 2 tails), and she seems to be ill. Norie takes her in and attempts to care for her, despite her own financial troubles.

(Source: MangaHelpers)

47552.description:
Welcome to the countryside village of Asahigaoka, a quaint town far-removed from the hustle-and-bustle of the big city. You couldn’t imagine a more isolated setting in all of Japan. So when Tokyo-raised elementary school student Hotaru Ichijou transfers to the tiny Asahigaoka Branch School due to her father’s job, she’s in the for the culture shock of her life!

Join Hotaru and her new friends, the eccentric Renge, and the mischevious sisters Natsumi and Komari, as they share daily adventures in the idyllic Japanese countryside.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Chapter count includes 6 extras.

47554.description:
With this book, Hirata set out to draw a passionate critique of discrimination against the Japanese outcaste community, known as the burakumin, around the character of Gennosuke, a young buraku whose mission to avenge and uplift his people through the sword goes horribly and gorily wrong. Though clearly intended as an anti-discrimination broadside, Bloody Stumps Samurai rubbed the Buraku Liberation League the wrong way, leading to copies being confiscated and burned and Hirata temporarily blacklisted.

(Source: Retrofit Comics)

title.native: 血だるま剣法・おのれらに告ぐ
PEACH-PIT 初期作品集 もものたね

47556.description:
Kaori, an ordinary office lady, has never been popular in her 21 years of life. On the contrary, she has the worst days, being pushed work onto her by her colleagues and being targeted by molesters. Then, Kaori's new boss, Makabe, joins her department and declares with a smile, "I'll turn you into a beautiful woman." But there's one condition...!

A dangerous after work encounter between a plain office lady and her celebrity boss!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

47557.description: Rui is an ordinary female college student. Her boyfriend Renji is No.1 popular host at a club!! The two are imbalanced in every respect, but they love each other very much. One day, however, Renji unexpectedly says good-bye!? There seems some reason...? This comic book is the 4th in the series "Anacha.

title.native: もっと×3 あなたのおもちゃ

47560.description:
1. Omoi Omoware Suri Surare (想い想われスリスラレ)
2. Tadaima Cohunai Junkaichuu!! (ただいま町内巡回中!!)
3. Yosoji Aika (四十路哀歌)
4. Ah, Seishun no Iwakisou!! (嗚呼、青春の岩鬼荘!!)
5. Yasai Ouji!! (野菜王子!!)
6. Gunyuu Kakkyo de Ii ja Nai! (群雄割拠でイイじゃない！)

title.native: 想い想われスリスラレ
団地にロボがやってきた
title.romaji: Danchi ni Robo ga Yatte Kita

47565.description: Futagami Sousuke, a normal junior high lives a normal life, until one night when he meets his ID, a collective of his residual feelings. His ID must be terminated before it kills him and replaces him.......what will occur in the life of Futagami Sousuke?

title.native: 金色のときがすぎても

47575.description:
The volume release contains :
1. Kore Kara no Signal (これからのシグナル)
2. Itsumo Hot Paradise (いつもホット・パラダイス)
3. Shigatsu no Himawari (4月のひまわり)
4. Blue no Hane wo Motteru (ブルーの羽根をもってる)

47576.description: The story of a stylish and gaudy girl who strives to win the heart of the boy she likes.

title.native: メタリック・カラーズ
セーラー・エンジェル

47582.description: Hirose Arisu's dream is to be a mangaka! But is it as simple as it seems? Will she be able to rise to being a great mangaka like her classmate Usami? Or will she continue to be a failure...?

47583.description: Maju has a cool face, but because of her name she's afraid of being called "Majo" (a witch). She has an unexpected meeting with three boys who ask her to help them out, and in an act of mercy they changed her into a different person.

title.native: マジョカル★マジョカル

47584.description: Maaya had to laugh to get through the tough times, until a strange bouquet of flowers left on her desk led her to discover the mysterious garden called "Flower Garden F," which changed every day!

47588.description: My name is Rina Uchida, a thirteen-year-old girl. As my parents live overseas due to my father's transfer, I stay with our distant relative Yoshikawa family. In the family are twin brothers, Naoya and Yuya. Naoya is unfriendly but Yuya who is my type is very nice. However, there is weird creature Bucket Purin in the family...!?

47589.description:
Does everyone know how to become a Santa Claus...? Yukimura Kiyoka is a 14-year-old 'Santa apprentice' who is working her hardest to achieve her dream of becoming a real Santa. The problem is she's still not good enough! She can barely drive her sleigh correctly! Will intensive training from her cousin be enough to help her pass her exam on Christmas.

Note: Includes the one-shot "Dreaming Santa Claus".

title.native: 恋はオン・エア! ; 夢みるサンタクロース

47590.description:
A compilation of 4 different stories by four different authors.

Story 1: Much to Komatsu Anri’s dismay, she ends up switching bodies with her twin brother Senri. However, in this case, the switch was a deliberate action by Senri! For reasons unknown to Anri, Senri used a book of magic and performed a spell that caused the switch. Anri is horrified and can’t understand why Senri, who has always been her best friend and closest person, could do such a thing. Senri hints that the reason for the switch is so that he could be close as a girl to his classmate and good friend Hokuto. But it’s Anri who ends up close to Hokuto because she must act like Senri at school. Hokuto is good friends with Senri, so Anri suddenly finds herself talking to him a lot… and falling for him…

Story 2: The heroine, Ruby, is a student at Princess Gakuen. Her grades are poor, and she is looked down upon by the snooty girls at her school. One day she rescues a little frog from being squashed by her arrogant classmate Crystal. For some reason, Ruby is not surprised when the frog talks to her. His name is Silver. He and Ruby become good friends. Meanwhile, a prince from a southern country is visiting the school, and a ball is being held in his honor. All the girls at the school are after the prince and want his kiss, including Ruby… will she live happily ever after?

Story 3: A girl meets a guy who is a popular idol and discovers his magical secret!

Story 4: A michevious ghost helps a girl find romance

title.native: ちぇんじ！～ちがうワタシになれたなら～
title.romaji: Change!: Chigau Watashi ni Nareta Nara

47592.description:
In the Miyawaki Yukino no Kessakushuu series:

1) Kimi wa Field no Kaze
2) 1/2000-byou Dreaming (Nisenbun no Ichibyou Dreaming)
3) Heart ni Whistle!

title.native: きみはフィールドの風

47594.description:
Vol 1. Kimi ga Tenshi ni Mieru Toki (When You Look Like an Angel)
"If you try really hard playing tennis, you will be given angel wings," a boy told Yuuka when she was small. She still plays tennis, believing his words. She finally encounters the boy when she grows up.

Two specials included in this volume.
7. Signal of the Fifth Year
8. Young Striker

Vol 2. Kamisama no Mistake

Vol 3. Itazura na 24 Ji (Naughty 24)
Wakana, 16 years of age, happens to live by herself. At her new apartment, she finds that she is going to live with the idol Takuto.
synonyms: Kimi ga Tenshi ni Mieru Toki

title.native: ゆきのプロジェクト; きみが天使に見えるとき; 神様のミステイク; いたずらな24時

47595.description:
1. Docchi ga Akuma YO? (Docchi ga Akuma YO?)
Liz, a devil apprentice, comes to the human world where his final examination to become a full-fledged devil takes place. The content of the examination is to make Kanato, a boy, unhappy within seven days. Being affectionate by nature, Liz fails no matter what she tries.

2. Strange x Strap (ストレンジ×ストラップ)
3. Love Delivery (ラブデリバリー)
4. Lazy Crazy Cupid (レイジー・クレイジー・キューピッド)
5. Skajan☆Junkie (スカジャン☆ジャンキー)
6. Chinpira Chost (チンピラゴースト)

47596.description:
Nakamura Mei is a very simple high school girl. While at a cafe with her friends, they bump in to -none other than- the model Shirou's table. Mei apologizes and that's when Shirou notices something. Grabbing her he takes her outside with him and reveals that Mei was once a kids model - and that he's her idol-otaku!?

(Source: CoyoMoose)

Included one-shots:
Volume 2: Wonderful Cafe ni Youkoso, Anya Kouro.

47597.description:
Sankaku is going to graduate from junior high soon, and she is a girl who treats many things with cold cynicism because of a disappointing romance during elementary school. She now does not have the courage to love and decides to bury her feelings for her long-time crush, Yokosuka, and graduate without telling him about how she feels. One day, she happens to run into Yokosuka and his friends, plotting to do something stupid on graduation day. Soon, Sankaku is caught in their crazy plan!

Contains 5 oneshots.

47598.description: Tsugumi, age 16, is secretly married to her class teacher, Takuto. Her rivals appear one after another, and she has to struggle tiding over love crises.
synonyms: Forever Love Love I Love You

title.native: ず～っとすき・すき・だいすきっ

47599.description: The story centers on Lieru, a girl who has a one-sided crush on a boy. She wants to go to the same school with the boy no matter what — and she somehow gets her wish granted.

title.native: くるるんっ☆りえるチェンジ！

47600.description: Suzu is an extremely energetic girl who believes that one shouldn't waste opportunities that are granted to them. So why is it that she hasn't been able to find a boyfriend all these years?

47601.description:
Juuza is a total rebel who obeys and bows to absolutely no one, and with his terrible self taught fighting style, he has absolutely no one to fear.

Juuza once gave up on his true love since he realized blood relation made a relationship impossible... But now that she is dead, Juuza has a thing or two to say to the man who was unable to protect her.
synonyms: Houkou no Kumo - Hokuto no Ken Juuza Gaiden

title.native: 彷徨の雲　北斗の拳　ジュウザ外伝

47603.description:
1-3. Antan (Despair)
4. Antan Yuzu (Despair Yuzu)
5. Keiji
6. Hiyoku Renri

47605.description:
1-2. After School Love
3. Stay With Me?
4. The Wolf Arrives!
5. Table of Yagi Family. (The Yagi Family's Dinner Table)
6. bitter black
7. Sweet white
8. Hibernation
synonyms: The Other Side of the Wall

47606.description:
The story revolves around Takumi Tsuzuki, a boy who lives with his older "sister" Otome, although the two have no blood ties between them. Otome manages a run-down confectionery store called Stray Cats. One day, Otome picks up a mysterious beautiful girl off the streets.

(Source: Anime News Network)

47607.description:
Two years ago, Tachibana Junichi got his heart broken by a girl who didn't show up for a date on Christmas Eve. Now a second year student in high school, Junichi spends his days inside his closet planetarium, going to school and hanging out with his friends Tanamachi Kaoru and Umehara Masayoshi.

Based on the Amagami love simulation game. The focus is on Tachibana Junichi's relationship with Tsukasa Ayatsuji. The second arc focuses on Kaoru Tanamachi.

47609.description: Sayu was quite surprised when the popular Yano-senpai told her that he likes her. Nevertheless, she is still happy to go out with him. But when others start asking why would Yano-senpai want to go out with someone like her, Sayu can’t help but also wonder why...

47614.description:
It's been eight years since Ishida and Yano shared a very awkward moment during their graduation from Seiryou High.

After college, Ishida hadn't seen or heard from his best friend for over three years. One day, he briefly glimpses Yano on a passing train. When did he come back and why do his friends insist it couldn't possibly be Yano? Ishida begins a desperate search for his missing friend with the old Student Council in tow.
(From Blissful Sin)

title.native: それでもまだ君の事が…

47617.description:
This one-shot is the adaptation of two movies: Zatoichi's Vengeance (Tokuzo Tanaka) and Zatoichi's Pilgrimage (Kazuo Ikehiro).

The Ballad of Zatoichi: Zatoichi comes upon a dying man who asks him to give a bag of money to "Taichi." Zatoichi has no idea who this is but when he comes upon a small town harassed by gangsters, he finds that "Taichi" was the man's young son. Along his travels, he also met a blind monk who makes Zatoichi question his murderous lifestyle. In trying to help the town, Zatoichi kills some gangsters and becomes a hero to the boy. He must make a choice of whether to stay and defend the town or to leave and be on his way.

Zatoichi's Pilgrimage: After he's ambushed in a small village terrorized by a gang of thieves, the legendary blind swordsman Zatoichi is forced to kill a young man in self-defense. As fate would have it, his travels soon lead him to Okichi, a woman whom Zatoichi discovers is the sister of the young man whose life he stole. In anger, Okichi attacks the blind swordsman, but her conscience gets the better of her, and as she tends his wounds, the two fall in love.

(Source: Manga-Updates)

47620.description: Official comic anthology for Kichiku Megane that includes an illustration and comments from the main artist Fuuri Misasagi.

title.native: 鬼畜眼鏡公認コミックアンソロジー

47621.description:
After failing Japanese history, Mio was force to go to extra cram classes. Finding out that his Japanese history teacher, Fumichika, was quite understanding and kind, Mio couldn't help but felt an attraction towards him. After he confessed, Fumichika tells him that his feelings won't last, but if he can accept the risk of not having his feelings reciprocated and may end up hurt, they can start a physical relationship. But when Mio desires more...

(Source: Bliss)
synonyms: Ashita no Kimi wa Kokoni Inai
The you of tomorrow is not here

title.native: あしたのきみはここにいない
title.romaji: Ashita no Kimi wa Koko ni Inai

47622.description:
Contains 5 one-shot stories and a 3 page omake:
1) Tenshi wa Maiorita - Taki really wants a boyfriend but has been turned down 7 times. She finds a white feather in the school court yard. According to school legend, she will be granted a wish by the "angel feather". Akira, Taki's classmate, also finds a feather... whose wish will be granted?

2) Kimi o Miteita - Yuiko saved a dog from being hit by a car and fell in love with the dog's owner Yoshiyuki when he smiled at her. Yuiko watches Yoshiyuki from the window of the pet store where he works but one day Yoshiyuki invites her into the store. The two start to get to know one another, but does Yoshiyuki remember who Yuiko is?

3) Bokura no Power - Kamura-sensei's first story to be published in Ribon. A story about Minori and Sakaki trying to win a sports competition with their class and realize their feelings for each other at the same time...

4) Issho Da Ne - Toda Fumio and Toda Keisuke gets teased because they are a boy and a girl with the same surename in the same class. Keisuke laughs it off while Fumio getes embarrassed, but what is Keisuke really thinking?

5) Ohisama no Egao - Kamura-sensei's debut work. Koharu, a girl who always smiles, gets teased a lot by her classmate Hagiwara. But one day, Hagiwara stops teasing her and Koharu realizes she misses his teasing?

Summaries modified from Lijaka

47628.description: Bakumatsu Renka Karyuu Kenshiden takes place in the first year of Tokugawa when the Shogunate and the emperor's supporters fight for supremacy. Shizuki Rin is a girl growing up in a Dojo who lost her memory of the past. Secretly the dojo deals with information. Including the violent Shinsengumi, some bishies and children who aim to get stronger.

title.native: 幕末恋華・花柳剣士伝

47631.description:
1. Crying Silently
When Shino hears some ecchi sounds in the school storage area he never expects to find Koji sensei pleasuring himself. Koji, caught in the act begs Shino to keep it a secret, but what exactly is Shino to think of all this? And when Shino starts to fall in love what is he to do?

2. The Knuckleball of Love
Fuwa is an ex-professional baseball player, so when he is one day approached by a high school baseball coach and begged to train the students Fuwa reluctantly agrees. Can the team be saved and what why is the coach so touchy-feely?

3. Be It Today, Tomorrow or the Day After
Aosaki is a cram-school student but has no ambition. His daily routine leads him to a small store for dinner each night - but one night Renji (the owner) is accused of 'touching' his part timer (high school student, male). Aosaki saves Renji but as a result the part-timer quits. Aosaki, in a flash decision, decides to take over the part time job - but who knew teaching Renji could prove so much fun?

4. Please
Sen is in love with Kuruma a cafe owner and retired stunt man. By what means will he get his love across?

5. Sonjo Sokora no Otoko
Parent meets teacher, is it love at first sight?

6. My Wife's Got a Beard
The return of the second couple from Hey! Doctor. Gorou and Chiaki are lovers and so far have kept it secret from their families. But when Chiaki's parents walks in on them kissing Chiaki thinks its all over. However, upon finding out Gorou is the managing director of a wealthy company they give him Chiaki as his bride!
synonyms: We are Crying in the Mind
Kyou mo Ashita mo Asate mo

title.native: だまって泣いているのです

47633.description:
From Shinnen:
Band for Life!'s energetic Kuroko thinks of the popular band 'Nitro Pop' as her enemy because there was once when she was ignored by their unsociable vocalist cum guitarist, Niko. However, their songs and performances are so captivating that it's hard not to be mesmerised by them... Turns out there's a plan for them to perform at the same live event...?! With pure funk beat that's guaranteed to capture your heart, the emotional rock romance makes its grand appearance!

47634.description:
Compilation of short stories:

1) Tabetai Hito
Yuu carries the torch for her childhood friend Kyoshi; but he is a handsome player that always treats her as a child...

2) Mitsuiro no Houkago
The shy class representative Saetsuki watches the popular Koyano from afar. One day the teacher asks Saetsuki to help him with his studies, and when they are alone in the classroom he suddenly kisses her. What are his intentions?

3) Hazushite yo
Kinoshita has long admired Yamashita, especially his smile when he sees his girlfriend. Now she overhears Yamashita's girlfriend breaking up with him. The next day she is close by Yamashita when he meets his old girlfriend with her new boyfriend. To hide his embarrassment, Yamashita grabs hold of Kinoshita and kisses her. What will happen next?

4) Mado Goshi ni, Koi Shita (Mado Goshi no Ichimoku Hore no Koi)
The very shy Fumiko from the normal classes sees the cool Mibu from the advanced classes leaning out a window. Their eyes meet... Will Fumiko be able to overcome her shyness and show Mibu how she feels?
synonyms: Mado Goshi no Ichimoku Hore no Koi

47635.description:
Lara Hoerwick is visiting her uncle Harald, and starts playing a game on his computer while he is away. At first she is excited to find herself in the world of the Epitaph of Twilight, until she realizes that she's stuck in the game. To make matters worse, the game's world is about to be destroyed by the Cursed Wave. Lara's only hope is to set out in search of the Twilight Dragon.

(Source: .hack//Wikia)

47636.description:
Beautiful teachers and secretive extra-curriculum lessons!
White suits, sports, spectacles, and extremely attractive teachers!
If it were you, which teacher would you choose to go to for a “not allowed” lesson?!
Ikemen Teacher and Ikenai, a personal lesson after school?!
Extremely charming English teacher, Sanada Kyoichi, is as charming as a prince.
However, the truth is that he is a sadist that has made Yume turn into a person with a slavery-characteristic!
He appeared in front of Yume, when she was a high school student, and he ordered her around with “order” and “praises” at a grade higher than his pervious commands, but…?!
Another white suit devil?!

A sadistic chemistry teacher and a killer-smile, spectacled history teacher. A total of three new sensational teacher love stories drawn by Nana-chan.

Includes :
1. Sensei wa Egotist (先生はエゴイスト)
2. Sensei no Koibito (先生の恋人)
3. Sensei no Kai Neko (先生の飼いネコ)
4. Sensei wa Egotist in Natsuyasum (先生はエゴイストin夏休み)

47637.description:
(Continuation of Ukkari Cherry's oneshot 'Nemurenu Yoru ni Nomikonda Hoshi'.)

After finally winning Sawa's heart and becoming his lover Shiroi still can't let himself be at ease--the more he's with Sawa, the more he realizes how frighteningly close Sawa and his best friend Micchan really are. And it doesn't help that Sawa seems to invite Micchan to go with them every time they can be alone. How can Shiroi make Sawa prove that he's really number one in Sawa's heart?

Also includes short stories 'Love Letter' and 'Kira Kira'.

title.native: パラダイス　ベイビー

47639.description:
Yorozu lives at Castle Mango, a "love hotel" where couples pay for a few hours to themselves. But his quiet life is violated when Togame arrives to shoot an adult film! Soon Yorozu's being "mistaken" for an actor, having his pants suddenly removed and watching his little brother get hit on. Togame eventually agrees to stay away from Yorozu's brother, but there's a catch - and it's not something Yorozu's going to like!

(Source: Juné)

47640.description:
1.Yoakemae (夜明け前)
Recently, An's boyfriend, Kurosawa, has been acting strangely. Did he just cancel their date for Sunday? It turns out that he's helping his best friend, Kouta, who is in love with this other girl. But does he have to do this in spite of An's feelings!?

2. Onaji Sora no Shita (同じ宇宙の下)
3. Niji no Ame (虹の雨)
4. Scratch Go-go (スクラッチ ゴーゴー)

47641.description: The somewhat precocious and sadistic girl 'Mitsuba', the somewhat lecherous muscle girl 'Futaba', and the somewhat mysterious girl 'Hitoha'. Better known as the (mischievous) "Marui Sisters", this is the story of how these three triplets go about their days in Class 6-3 with their cute yet wild antics.

47643.description: This is a story from the same author of Shiawase Kissa Sanchoume, Matsuzuki Kou.

47644.description:
The manga is based on a dramatic tragedy diary written by Aya Kito, published shortly before her death. The diary, a true story based on her own life, was originally written in first person. It is about a girl coping with her teenage life along with a degenerative disease. She keeps a diary of not only what she does but how she feels and the hardships she must endure. Initially, the diary's purpose was for Kito to chronicle impressions she had about how the disease was affecting her daily life. As the disease progressed, however, the diary became Kito's outlet for describing the intense personal struggles she underwent in coping, adapting, and ultimately trying to survive her disease. As she notes in one entry, "I write because writing is evidence that I am still alive."

(Source: Wikipedia)

47645.description:
A collection of short stories:

1-2. 10after
3. Fuuki Iinchou no Seiheki (風紀委員長の性癖, Tendency of the Student Council Pr.)
4. Fuuki Iinchou no Katsubou (風紀委員長の渇望, Hunger of the Student Council President)
5. Utsukushiki Josei (美しき女性, Belladonna)
6. Yureru Riyuu (揺れる理由, Wavering Reason)
7. Haru no Dekigoto (春の出来事, One Day in Spring)
8. Shoka no Dekigoto (初夏の出来事, The Beginning of Summer )
9. Tanoshii Sei Rigaku (楽しい性理学, Plesurable Physiology)
10. Id 〜Ido〜 (id〜イド〜)

47647.description:
"Yu-chan I’ve been wanting to see you this whole time, I’m presently going to Tokyo..."
Mugiko is a very energetic girl that was raised in a rural agricultural village within the mountain area. In order for her to see Yu-chan, who she was extremely close with when they were children, she transfers to a school in Tokyo. It has been three years since Mugiko has seen Yu-chan, but when they meet each other again he treats her coldly. Mugiko is shocked by this, but a very kind prince type boy appears…!?

(Source: Chibi Manga)

47648.description:
“Young Master, please stop teasing me!”
“How am I supposed to do such a thing to you, Master?!”

After my Mom gets into an accident, I had to go in her stead to be a maid in the noble Takaido household. However, it’s not an ordinary maid job, I am assigned to serve a slightly perverted and saucy young master?!

Includes:
Obocchama no Otanoshimi (Young Master's Pleasure)
Obocchama no Otawamure (Young Master's Joke)
Obocchama no Okiniiri (Young Master's Favorite)
Amanogawa Distance (Milky Way Distance)
Hibari Shokudou he Irasshai! (Welcome to the Hibari Dining Hall!)

title.native: おぼっちゃまのお愉しみ

47649.description:
Sunohara Momota just recently transferred schools to a quiet part of the country and is settling in. He seems to be fitting in quite nice and already has a couple of friends, a lot of them girls. First there is Natsumiya Sayuri, the class president, who everyone seems to like and then there is Touno Ume, the shy cute girl. He is slowly progressing with each one but can’t really understand which one he likes more. And then there is the girl who he talks to everyday online who he still hasn’t met. Who is Momota going to end up with and what will happen to the girl who doesn’t get what she wants?

(Source: MangaHelpers)

47650.description:
Adapted from the Agatha Christie novel The Secret of Chimneys.

1) The Secret of Chimneys
2) Sparkling Cyanide
3) Towards Zero
4) Extra

47657.description:
After a fallout with his father, Alvin takes time off to visit India and indulge in his love of exotic places. When he meets Razil, it's love at first sight and the two of them return to England as lovers. But Razil has a dangerous past in India that Alvin knows nothing about.

(Source: Dangerous Pleasure)

47659.description:
Chihiro Kouzuki is a stage actor and works part-time as a housekeeper to earn more money. His uncle called him about taking on a housekeeping job for Aoki, an elite businessman who lives in an expensive condo. Chihiro accepts, not realising how demanding Aoki can be about how he wants his condo tidied up.
He is so demanding that Chihiro is starting to lose his patience with him...

47660.description: Ootori Rara is searching for a fragrance which is sweet and kind, a fragrance she had once known a long time ago...

47661.description:
Riku is the son of a well-known announcer and actress and he hates it. He hates being a celebrity kid, and since he shares the same voice as his father, he also hates his voice despite it being an asset. With Riku's coming-of-age ceremony coming up, his father decides to buy him a suit, the reason being most of Riku's clothes consisted of street fashion. In the store, he meets the owner and tailor, Kiichi Hiiragi, a married man who has a way with words and finding the right suit. Riku becomes suspicious of Kiichi and as it turns out, Kiichi's feelings for his father is more than just being a fan; Kiichi has a thing for older men. Things take a turn between the two of them and Riku finds himself attracted to Kiichi, but the question is - does Kiichi like him back?

(Source: Futekiya)

47662.description: Short story about two guys, who usually watch films together. The story tells the older guy's thoughts.

47666.description:
Renji and Kenta are musicians, they meet each other thanks to the friendship between their bands. Each musician has different reasons to play, be it love for the music, a strong desire to surpass their fears on stage or even just for someone's approbation.
While these bands are struggling to be known in such a competitive world, Kenta is struggling with a different problem in his love life; can he be a replacement for someone else?

A heartwarming story about feelings that grow deep without being noticed.

title.native: ノン ティー ルーム

47668.description: Cys Buegette learns of the sudden death of his brother he didn't see for 10 years. His only legacy: a disk and a son, Kai. Kai now lives with Cys and every night, comes to his bed.

47673.description: Mitsuya and Noko have been friends since forever. She's a little dumb and clumsy, but cute and Mitsuya totally has a crush on her... but as far as he knows, he's nothing to her.

47675.description:
Collection of short stories:

• Himitsu no Oniisan

• Yome ni Konai ka

• Love Cafe

• Darenimo Ienai!!

47677.description:
To tell the truth, my life is awesome. God is definitely listening to my wishes. And that wish from me, Sakuragi Yuuka, is to have a love that makes my heart go “kyuun”!!! See, the boy of my dreams, Tamiya-kun, has already showed up right before my eyes!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: Fushigi na Chikara de: My Mysterious Power
シークレット・パラダイス

47678.description:
A collection of short stories:

1. The Power of Acting is Power. What is Mari's problem? She's acting cold and harsh to her brother, Tatsuya. But no one knows of her erotic dreams and her secret forbidden love...
2. Ganbaru Volley-Bu.
3. Chiropractic Time.
4. It Will Be Book-On if a Wife Is Sold.
5. Steel Angel

Source: mangaupdates
synonyms: The Power of Acting is Power
